thread:
maria: FYI scanner (creds-sleuth) flagged a base64 blob in a third-party error log uploaded to s3://partner-errors/redwood/2026-03-22/err-123.log. It looks like a Vault transit ciphertext referencing KMS key 'projects/rdw/kms/keys/backup-rot-04' and a vault path secret/data/backup-service. Possible leak of backup-service DB creds. Need containment + rotation ASAP.

sam: ack. can you paste a redacted snippet (no plaintext secrets)?

maria: redacted snippet below — ciphertext only + metadata: 
```
ERROR: payload: "CmV0cmlldmVfYnl0ZXM..." metadata: {"vault_path":"secret/data/backup-service","kms_key":"backup-rot-04"}
```

alex: tagging @infra-oncall. infra, can you block the partner bucket public access and snapshot the object. capture version id and ACLs.

infra-oncall: on it. applied bucket policy deny for partner account and blocked public access. captured object version v3 -> gs://incident-archives/1790123456-obj-v3. kept original metadata and request logs.

sam: we should rewrap the Vault transit ciphertext and rotate the DB password. follow the emergency rewrap + rotation runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/secret-leak. I'll open PRs for rotation changes. @jess can you prepare canary to validate rotated creds in staging?

jess: will run canary after rotation. ETA ~20m.

maria: also request KMS rekey: create new key backup-rot-05 and perform rewrap flow from 04->05 before we rotate DB password so old ciphertexts cannot be unwrapped by partner.

alex: preparing IAM patch to revoke partner-sa from KMS key usage and remove any lingering grants. will push in ~5m.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 created, severity P2. Notifying compliance and SRE leads.

sam: action items (short):
1) block bucket + archive object (infra-oncall)
2) revoke partner KMS grants (alex)
3) create backup-rot-05 + rewrap ciphertexts (sam)
4) rotate DB creds and reissue to services (sam/jess)
5) export audit logs & draft disclosure memo (maria)
I'll update here with PR/CL links.

infra-oncall: bucket blocked, object archived and checksums verified. request logs exported to /tmp/incident-1790123456-logs.tar.gz.

alex: IAM CL: 8472 submitted — revoked partner-sa from KMS key binding and removed keyring access. waiting CL review.

sam: created new key backup-rot-05 (kms). starting rewrap job: `vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@/tmp/ciphertext --target-key=backup-rot-05` (kicking off, will log output).

maria: filing short disclosure to partner legal + SRE (minimal metadata). keeping details internal.

jess: canary run after rotation: passed against staging with new creds; no regressions observed.

sam: DB creds rotated, services reissued tokens/certs. updating the incident tracker: rotation complete.

maria: thanks team. follow-ups: schedule RBAC audit for Vault and KMS usage next week, add automated alerts for ciphertexts in partner logs. will own compliance memo.

alex: +1 to RBAC audit.

sec-bot: INC-2026-0421 status changed: active -> monitoring.

maria: closing loop here; will ping again once compliance sign-off is in.
